bounds_justification.explanation: Independent ISA interpretation has 1300 instruction events, including ten traps and two terminal JAL retirements. A 160-cycle/event planning allowance gives 208000 cycles; 32000 additional cycles cover cold fetch, handler redirects and service stalls. 240000 is an abort cap, not a proved cycle-performance bound. Both matched schedules must finish under this cap and the independent 120-second native timeout.
